Thick smoke and haze blanketed the Metro Manila skyline as seen from a building along Taft Avenue on Sunday, April 12, 2026, following a fire at the Navotas Sanitary Landfill.

Local government units, including the City of Manila, advised residents to stay indoors and wear N95 masks after air quality reached unhealthy levels.

📸 Jonas Sulit, Abante
